title: help lists the shortcuts in the bin beside a device's code
intention: The base shim's bin_shortcuts lists a device's shortcuts from both bins the launcher runs: the instance bin and the bin/ beside the device's code (cairn/devices/<device>/bin/), the instance bin's entry winning a shared name, and a Python script's about is its docstring's first line when no comment line comes first.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: `bin/cairn help` shows [cairn] as `cairn` alone, though `cairn start`, `cairn stop` and `cairn restart` run from cairn/devices/cairn/bin/ (30366e99655a, 3264ef726e35); bin_shortcuts reads only the instance bin, so help hides every shortcut that lives beside the code, where 5.4.3.3 puts them.
traces_to: Outline 5.4.3.3 (any device or machine may have a bin/ beside its code; that folder IS its list of shortcuts) and 2.4.11.1 (help answers as list does, readable cold); Law 1 (a shortcut that help does not list is re-derived by reading folders).
how: In cairn/tools/base/shim.py: bin_shortcuts gains class_root (default CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT, else the devices folder beside cairn/tools, i.e. Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'devices') and returns the instance bin's executables plus the class bin's whose name the instance bin lacks, sorted by name, the row shape unchanged. _first_comment also takes the text after an opening triple quote. cold_list and the shim's live help already call bin_shortcuts, so both list the class bin.

clauses.claim: with a scratch class root whose fxhb/bin holds an executable Python `wave` whose docstring opens `wave — waves the fixture` and a scratch instance root whose fxhb/0/bin holds an executable `frob` with comment `frob — turns the crank`, bin_shortcuts('fxhb', instance_root, 0, class_root) returns [frob, wave] in that order, each with that about
a name both bins hold is listed once, with the instance bin's about
a non-executable file in the class bin is absent, and a device with neither bin returns []

with class_root omitted and CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT unset, bin_shortcuts('cairn', <a scratch instance root with no cairn bin>) lists restart, start and stop, with abouts beginning `cairn restart —`, `cairn start —` and `cairn stop —`
cold_list('fxhb', instance_root) under CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT=<the clause-1 class root> carries frob and wave in its data's shortcuts and in its text

decisions.text: D1: cairn/tools/base/shim.py: bin_shortcuts(device_id, instance_root=None, instance=0, class_root=None). class_root resolves as class_root, else os.environ['CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT'] when set, else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'devices'. Rows: each executable file of the instance bin, then each executable file of class_root/<device_id>/bin whose name no instance row has; sorted by name; shape {'name', 'about'} unchanged. _first_comment: a stripped line that starts with '"""' or "'''" returns the text after those three characters with any closing triple quote removed and stripped, when non-empty; # comments keep their rule; whichever comes first in the file wins. The docstring of bin_shortcuts cites outline 5.4.3.3 and this ticket.

D2: the proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_help_lists_the_bin_beside_the_code.py, red-first, one tooth per clause, PROVES {'ba777080011b': {'1': 'both_bins_are_listed_in_order', '2': 'the_instance_bin_wins_a_shared_name', '3': 'non_executables_and_empty_devices_list_nothing', '4': 'the_default_class_root_is_the_repos_devices', '5': 'cold_list_carries_the_class_bin', '6': 'the_standing_help_proofs_pass'}}. Worlds from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir as cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_help_answers_as_list_with_shortcuts.py builds them; tooth 4 pops CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT in a subprocess; tooth 6 runs the two proofs as subprocesses and asserts exit 0.

out: bin/cairn's _help (its instance-bin guard and device roster): its own ticket on bin

measured.saw: help lists [cairn] as `cairn` alone; bin_shortcuts reads only the instance bin
measured.how: bin/cairn help | sed -n '/^\[cairn\]/,/^$/p'; read cairn/tools/base/shim.py bin_shortcuts
